notes:
Method. The frozen v1.13.2 instruction was read in full. The filing's Background of the Merger (printed pp.27-35) was read in order, then the passages it points to: p.36 (27 bidders, 23 confidentiality agreements, 'submit and affirm best and final'), p.19, p.3, p.62 and Annex A pp. A-1/A-32. Every expected value is anchored in that text. All source_quotes were checked mechanically as whitespace-normalised verbatim substrings of the extracted filing text, including the new DA-F09 quote (p.30) and the phrases added to DA-C04 (p.31, 09/23 call) and DA-C05 (p.29, executive presentations). Leads, used only as leads: the verified revision datalink_revised.xlsx, ADJUDICATION.md (F1-F11, L1, Austin's F9 ruling), CORRECTION_BRIEF, VERIFICATION.md, population_reconciliation.json, source inventory S01-S18, fresh_review.md, and Alex's rows at Excel 2822-2873. Where Alex's conventions conflict with the instruction, they were not imported: group range put on individuals; Party A dropped 04/20 and 07/27; C dropped 10/20; B dropped 11/06; NDAs dated 06/06; IOIs dated to due dates.

Grading conventions. Weights: participation 30, rounds 25, formality_conditions 20, chronology 10, bids_prices 10, other 5; 45 tests. Half credit is 0.5 of the test weight. Round numbers follow the adopted five-round map (Austin's F9 ruling). Penalise a different map once, in DA-R02 or DA-R04 (or DA-R06 for folding October), and grade every other test by stage identity, e.g. under a June-round-1 map expected round n becomes n-1. The Inferred flag is scored only where a check says so. Accepted alternatives earn full credit. No test depends on wording, Note length, row counts or the number of Questions.
